key.name: primary-vendor
key.summary: Primary vendor selected in the popup
key.description: The default vendor selected in the popup. Panel vendors are configured separately.

key.name: active-vendor
key.description: The vendor selected by scroll-cycling; defaults to the primary vendor.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often usage is fetched. The minimum of 300 seconds avoids the upstream endpoints' aggressive rate limiting.

key.name: bar-format
key.description: Used for a vendor's top-panel label when its custom label is empty. Supports placeholders from that vendor's value set.

key.name: panel-vendors
key.description: Only selected and enabled vendors are displayed and automatically refreshed on the top panel. Order follows the vendor list.

key.name: bar-format-anthropic
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: bar-format-openai
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: bar-format-zai
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: bar-format-openrouter
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: bar-format-deepseek
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: bar-format-kimi
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: bar-format-ollama
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: bar-format-custom
key.description: Empty uses the default panel label.

key.name: tooltip-format
key.description: Optional template for the popup. An empty value uses the built-in structured layout.

key.name: color-low
key.description: Hex color (#rrggbb) for the low-severity tier. Empty derives the color from the active theme.

key.name: color-mid
key.description: Hex color (#rrggbb) for the mid-severity tier. Empty derives the color from the active theme.

key.name: color-high
key.description: Hex color (#rrggbb) for the high-severity tier. Empty derives the color from the active theme.

key.name: color-critical
key.description: Hex color (#rrggbb) for the critical-severity tier. Empty derives the color from the active theme.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which area of the top panel holds the indicator: left, center (beside the clock) or right (beside the system menu).

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Where the indicator sits inside its area; 0 is the leftmost. In the center area 0 is left of the clock and 1 right of it.

key.name: toggle-menu
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the popup. An empty list disables it.

key.name: show-vendor-icons
key.description: Show each vendor's logo as the panel badge and in the popup headers. Off shows the vendor's short code on the panel and a generic icon in the popup.

key.name: show-pace-marker
key.summary: Show the elapsed-position marker on popup bars
key.description: When enabled, each popup window bar draws a thin marker at the fraction of the window that has elapsed, so usage can be compared against pace at a glance.

key.name: notify-enabled
key.summary: Notify when usage crosses the threshold
key.description: When enabled, a desktop notification is shown the first time a usage window reaches the notification threshold. It fires once per crossing and re-arms after usage drops more than 7 points below the threshold or the window resets. A banked reset credit is also announced once, 48 hours before it expires.

key.name: notify-threshold
key.description: Usage percentage of any single window at which a notification fires; 100 and above is sent as critical. Vendors without a percentage (DeepSeek) never notify.

key.name: update-check-enabled
key.description: When enabled, the extension asks the GitHub API once a day for the latest release and shows a link in the popup when it is newer than the installed version. No request is made while this is off.

key.name: context-enabled
key.description: When enabled, the Claude section lists recent Claude Code sessions and how much of their context window the latest response used. Nothing is read from disk while this is off.

key.name: context-projects-path
key.description: Where the session transcripts (*.jsonl) live. Empty means ~/.claude/projects.

key.name: context-window-tokens
key.description: Context window size used when a session's model has no entry in the model windows. 0 means not configured: raw token counts are shown instead of a percentage.

key.name: context-model-windows
key.description: A JSON object of model name to context window size in tokens, e.g. {"claude-opus-5": 1000000}. Entries with an empty name or a non-positive size are ignored.

key.name: anthropic-enabled
key.description: Whether the Anthropic vendor is polled and shown.

key.name: anthropic-credentials-path
key.description: Path to the Claude credentials file. Empty uses ~/.claude/.credentials.json.

key.name: openai-enabled
key.description: Whether the OpenAI/Codex vendor is polled and shown.

key.name: openai-codex-auth-path
key.description: Path to the Codex auth file. Empty uses ~/.codex/auth.json.

key.name: openai-admin-key-env
key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the OpenAI admin key for the API-key fallback path.

key.name: zai-enabled
key.description: Whether the Z.AI vendor is polled and shown.

key.name: zai-api-key-env
key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Z.AI API key (takes precedence over the inline key).

key.name: zai-api-key
key.description: Inline Z.AI API key used when the environment variable is unset. Empty means none.

key.name: zai-plan-tier
key.description: Display-only plan tier label (e.g. lite/pro/max). Empty means unset.

key.name: openrouter-enabled
key.description: Whether the OpenRouter vendor is polled and shown.

key.name: openrouter-api-key-env
key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the OpenRouter API key (takes precedence over the inline key).

key.name: openrouter-api-key
key.description: Inline OpenRouter API key used when the environment variable is unset. Empty means none.

key.name: deepseek-enabled
key.description: Whether the DeepSeek vendor is polled and shown. Off by default; requires an API key.

key.name: deepseek-api-key-env
key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the DeepSeek API key (takes precedence over the inline key).

key.name: deepseek-api-key
key.description: Inline DeepSeek API key used when the environment variable is unset. Empty means none.

key.name: kimi-enabled
key.description: Whether the Kimi vendor is polled and shown. Off by default; requires an API key.

key.name: kimi-api-key-env
key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Kimi API key (takes precedence over the inline key).

key.name: kimi-api-key
key.description: Inline Kimi API key used when the environment variable is unset. Empty means none.

key.name: ollama-enabled
key.description: Whether the Ollama Cloud vendor is polled and shown. Off by default; requires an API key.

key.name: ollama-api-key-env
key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the Ollama API key (takes precedence over the inline key).

key.name: ollama-api-key
key.description: Inline Ollama API key used when the environment variable is unset. Empty means none.

key.name: ollama-plan
key.description: Plan name shown in the popup title and the {plan} placeholder; the usage route does not report one. Empty shows just "Ollama".

key.name: custom-enabled
key.description: Whether the user-defined provider is polled and shown.

key.name: custom-name
key.description: Label of the custom provider (1–48 characters); its first three letters become the panel badge.

key.name: custom-url
key.description: The https:// URL that answers a GET with JSON. No user name or password in the URL.

key.name: custom-allow-http
key.description: Accept an http:// URL for the custom provider (e.g. a local service). Off by default.

key.name: custom-api-key-env
key.summary: Custom provider API key environment variable
key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key; empty uses only the inline key.

key.name: custom-api-key
key.description: Inline key used when the environment variable is unset. Empty sends no auth header.

key.name: custom-auth-header
key.description: Header that carries the key.

key.name: custom-auth-scheme
key.description: Prefix sent before the key (e.g. Bearer). Empty sends the key bare.

key.name: custom-extra-headers
key.description: A JSON object of extra request headers, e.g. {"X-Team": "core"}. It must not repeat the auth header.

key.name: custom-mapping
key.description: A JSON object mapping response fields by JSON Pointer to metrics and texts. See the README.
